content.short: aelf is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain featuring multi-sidechain architecture and cloud-native computing.
content.description: aelf is an open-source, high-performance Layer 1 blockchain network designed as a complete business solution for decentralized enterprises. It utilizes a unique multi-sidechain architecture that allows for parallel processing and cross-chain communication, enabling high throughput without network congestion. By employing a Cloud Native node system, aelf provides developers with a scalable environment that can easily adapt to high-demand applications like large-scale gaming and enterprise-grade DeFi. The network's governance model allows for flexible upgrades through voter consensus, ensuring the protocol can evolve alongside the rapidly changing technological needs of the Web3 ecosystem.
content.meta: aelf is a scalable Layer 1 blockchain with a multi-sidechain architecture designed for enterprise-grade decentralized applications.
